snippet.title: Mixed Feelings Demo Now Available!
snippet.description:
THE GAME IS NOW AVAILABLE! http://spoonycatt.itch.io/mixed-feelings

Mixed Feelings is a game where you find yourself whisked away into a beautiful place that's strangely familiar. Join Peri, Silas, and Kahira as they take your through Asphodel Meadows, and fall deeper and deeper down the rabbit hole as you learn more about their lives, the world around you, and possibly...yourself?

If you're interested in weekly concept art, speed draws, behind the scenes, or just want to support my projects, consider backing me on Patreon! http://patreon.com/spoonycatt

My Twitter: http://twitter.com/spoonycatt
My tumblr: http://spoonycatt.com
My Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/h57Maje#_=_#_=_

Music is by caseJackal - http://case.dog/music/
